metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2020 · The Call

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2021 · Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Georgekutty be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2022 · Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2023 · Monster

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2024 · Anatomy of a Fall

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Promising Young Woman

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2022 · The Outfit
